name: Talents of Faerun â€” cache iter_resource across HLA summon spell_list
description: dw_talents #60200 EMPOWERED_MONSTER_SUMMONING calls iter_resource 11 times in a row (once per wizard summoning spell), each call doing a full recursive graph walk via math_traverse_graph. The graphs overlap heavily (creatures summoned by Monster Summoning 2 include all of MS1's plus a few new ones, etc.), so ~80-90% of the COPY_EXISTING + DECOMPILE_BCS_TO_BAF work is repeated from scratch on every call. Observed in session 6693001a: 237,330 'Copying and patching 1 file ...' ops in this one feat (~2h 58m wall clock). This patch adds an opt-in `keep_visited` parameter that preserves SFO_visited_nodes across calls, so subsequent iter_resource invocations short-circuit already-walked subgraphs. Estimated savings: 60-80% of the 3h â†’ 1.5-2h reduction. Three coordinated ops: (1) math_traverse_graph accepts the new param, (2) iter_resource forwards it, (3) empowered_creature_setup uses it with an outer ACTION_CLEAR_ARRAY once before the loop. Ops 1+2 are strictly backward-compatible (default keep_visited=0 preserves current behaviour for all other callers). Op 3 is the only behavioural change and only affects the 4 empowered_* summoning feats. Complements patch #58 (dedupe typo); both apply cleanly together.

ops.find:
DEFINE_DIMORPHIC_FUNCTION math_traverse_graph
	INT_VAR max_iterations=1000
			silent=0//boolean
			telemetry=0//boolean
	STR_VAR start=""
			relates_to=""//function
			parameter=""
	RET_ARRAY visited_nodes
BEGIN
	OUTER_SET stopped=0
	OUTER_SET count=0
	ACTION_CLEAR_ARRAY current_nodes
	ACTION_CLEAR_ARRAY SFO_visited_nodes // we need an internal version because otherwise iterated use leaves entries we can't clear reliably
ops.replace:
// _eetmr_graph_accumulator_v1: added opt-in `keep_visited` â€” when set, skip the SFO_visited_nodes
// reset so consecutive calls accumulate their traversals. Backward-compatible: default 0 preserves
// legacy per-call behaviour. Used by empowered_creature_setup's 11-spell loop to avoid re-walking
// shared summoning subgraphs on every spell (saves ~60-80% of a 3h dw_talents component).
DEFINE_DIMORPHIC_FUNCTION math_traverse_graph
	INT_VAR max_iterations=1000
			silent=0//boolean
			telemetry=0//boolean
			keep_visited=0//boolean â€” _eetmr_graph_accumulator_v1: when 1, skip the SFO_visited_nodes reset
	STR_VAR start=""
			relates_to=""//function
			parameter=""
	RET_ARRAY visited_nodes
BEGIN
	OUTER_SET stopped=0
	OUTER_SET count=0
	ACTION_CLEAR_ARRAY current_nodes
	ACTION_IF !keep_visited BEGIN
		ACTION_CLEAR_ARRAY SFO_visited_nodes // we need an internal version because otherwise iterated use leaves entries we can't clear reliably
	END

ops.find:
DEFINE_ACTION_FUNCTION iter_resource
	STR_VAR start=""
			ignore=""
			spell_use_function=""
			icon_function=""
	RET_ARRAY array
BEGIN
	OUTER_SPRINT SFO_reserved_function "%spell_use_function%"
	OUTER_SPRINT SFO_reserved_icon_function "%icon_function%"
	LAF math_traverse_graph STR_VAR start relates_to=iter_main parameter="%ignore%" RET_ARRAY array=visited_nodes END
ops.replace:
// _eetmr_graph_accumulator_v1: forward `keep_visited` to math_traverse_graph so callers can
// opt into cross-call accumulation of visited nodes. Default 0 is fully backward-compatible.
DEFINE_ACTION_FUNCTION iter_resource
	INT_VAR keep_visited=0//boolean â€” pass-through to math_traverse_graph
	STR_VAR start=""
			ignore=""
			spell_use_function=""
			icon_function=""
	RET_ARRAY array
BEGIN
	OUTER_SPRINT SFO_reserved_function "%spell_use_function%"
	OUTER_SPRINT SFO_reserved_icon_function "%icon_function%"
	LAF math_traverse_graph INT_VAR keep_visited STR_VAR start relates_to=iter_main parameter="%ignore%" RET_ARRAY array=visited_nodes END

name: Talents of Faerun â€” dedupe WIZARD_MONSTER_SUMMONING_1 in HLA summons
description: dw_talents #60200 (Revised HLA system) installs EMPOWERED_MONSTER_SUMMONING via empowered_creature_setup with a spell_list containing 11 wizard summoning spells. WIZARD_MONSTER_SUMMONING_1 is listed twice in hla_spec_summons.tph line 14 â€” almost certainly a typo. Each spell in the list triggers iter_resource (recursive graph walk via COPY_EXISTING + DECOMPILE_BCS_TO_BAF on every touched BCS) with no cross-call caching, so the duplicate re-walks the entire summoning subgraph. Observed in the session 6693001a install: EMPOWERED_MONSTER_SUMMONING alone emitted 237,330 'Copying and patching 1 file ...' lines out of 242,225 total for the component (~98%). Removing the duplicate saves one full graph walk â€” roughly 9% of the component's 3-hour wall clock (~15-20 min). Upstream bug (not an Infinity Mod Runner compatibility concern); reporting to dw_talents maintainer is orthogonal.

description: An earlier version of this patch added banter-stub-creation code to imoen_forever.tp2 before BEGIN @9928, but imoen_forever ALREADY has identical code inside its ALWAYS block (line 278). The redundant insertion ended up in an invalid position (between LANGUAGE declarations and the first component BEGIN), causing WeiDU parse errors. This patch cleans that up: if the erroneous block is present, remove it. If absent (fresh extract), no-op.

ops.find:
ACTION_IF GAME_INCLUDES ~sod~ THEN BEGIN
  // _eetmr_banter_stubs: SoD banter-file stub creation. SoD's banter engine
  // creates *B.DLG files at runtime; at install time BDIMOENB/BDCORWIB/etc.
  // don't exist, so CHAIN/APPEND_EARLY fails. Pattern borrowed from c#brage
  // and c#greythedog which have identical stub-creation logic.
  COPY_EXISTING ~BDBANTER.2DA~ ~%MOD_FOLDER%/install~
    COUNT_2DA_COLS eetmr_cols
    COUNT_2DA_ROWS eetmr_cols eetmr_rows
    FOR ( eetmr_row = 2 ; eetmr_row < eetmr_rows ; eetmr_row = eetmr_row + 1 ) BEGIN
      READ_2DA_ENTRY %eetmr_row% 0 2 eetmr_npc_dv
      READ_2DA_ENTRY %eetmr_row% 1 2 eetmr_banterfile
      INNER_ACTION BEGIN
        ACTION_IF NOT FILE_EXISTS_IN_GAME ~%eetmr_banterfile%.dlg~ THEN BEGIN
          <<<<<<<< .../eetmr-banter-stubs/%eetmr_banterfile%.d
          BEGIN %eetmr_banterfile%
          >>>>>>>>
          COMPILE EVALUATE_BUFFER ~.../eetmr-banter-stubs/%eetmr_banterfile%.d~
        END
      END
    END
  BUT_ONLY
END

name: Talents of Faerun â€” revert buggy GLOB additions (BIFF optimization attempt)
description: Reverts a previous failed attempt at BIFF optimization that inserted `GLOB` after the `-` modifier in 5 COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP BCS scan patterns in dw_talents. WeiDU's GLR parser rejects the `GLOB -` ordering (only `- GLOB` is valid), causing parse errors when the damaged files are encountered. Each op is a revert: it looks for the broken state (`COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP GLOB -` with the `_eetmr_glob_biff` comment) and restores the original working line (`COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP -`). All ops are `required: false`, so this safely no-ops on fresh installs that never received the buggy GLOB insertion.

ops._eetmr_note: Revert-op: subrace.tpa uses DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH inside a COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP ... nowhere block. Adding GLOB to that line causes WeiDU GLR parse error at the DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH token. Original (no GLOB) works because DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH handles BIF access implicitly. This op restores the original state on users who ran an earlier v1 of patch #53 that GLOB-ified this file.

_eetmr_recommended_note: Set recommended:false because: (1) all five ops already have required:false, so they silently no-op on fresh installs that never received the buggy v1 GLOB insertion; (2) the patch is only useful for installs that applied the bad v1 of this same patch #53 before it was reverted. Opt-in only â€” users who hit the specific GLR parse errors from v1 damage can manually enable.

In megainstalls with 250+ splstates (dw_talents 67, stratagems 50+, SubtleD 19, etc.), all 0-255 slots are taken. EE engines support indices >255 (stratagems uses 256-315 successfully). ops.replace:

							SET	new_ids = i	SET	i = 512	END

name: Imoen 4 Ever â€” clear stale do-once marker
description: imoen_forever's ALWAYS block wraps its one-time setup (banter-stub creation for BDIMOENB/BDCORWIB/etc., TRA loading) in a FILE_EXISTS guard that checks imoen_forever/Install/imoen_foreverinstall.mrk. Once the marker is created by a prior install, subsequent runs SKIP the do-once block â€” meaning no banter stubs on re-install, which breaks cn:14 'Give Imoen Dialogue Content in Chapters 8-12' with 'BDIMOENB.DLG not found for CHAIN3'. Fix: rename the marker aside so the ALWAYS block re-runs. rename_if_exists is idempotent â€” if the marker is already renamed/missing, no-op.

ops._eetmr_note: rename_if_exists with swapped src/dest works but is cryptic. delete_if_exists is semantically what the ALWAYS block's !FILE_EXISTS guard actually needs â€” the marker just has to not exist.

name: Enhanced Powergaming Scripts â€” drop POTN18 from BUFF_PRO_DAMAGE detectable-spells table
description: Removes the `POTN18` entry from the inline BUFF_PRO_DAMAGE.2da block in `enhanced-powergaming-scripts/lib/ds/ds.tph`. POTN18 (Potion of Absorption) is one of five potions this EPS component registers with DS tracking. On megainstalls some upstream mod leaves POTN18's ability header/structure-offsets inconsistent, which makes WeiDU's CLONE_EFFECT walker crash with 'cannot convert abil_num to an integer' â€” rolling back the entire 'Accelerated Pre-Buffing Speed' component (and its 2 siblings) with AUTO_SKIP. Dropping POTN18 from DS tracking loses one buff-detection entry but keeps the component installable. Observed Test #38 batch 509.

marker._eetmr_marker_note: Matches the 3-line broken-state sequence exactly, not just 'POTN18'. Bare 'POTN18' would false-trigger once patch #61 (PATCH_TRY wrap) reintroduces POTN18 as a substring in its explanatory comment.

ops._eetmr_note: Find includes the preceding and following potion so the patch anchors to the correct inline 2da block (BUFF_PRO_DAMAGE) rather than any other POTN18 mention in the file.

_eetmr_superseded_by: #61 (PATCH_TRY wrap around the CLONE_EFFECT walker). That patch handles ALL corrupt potions at once, not just POTN18 â€” Test #39 still failed on POTN45 because patch #60 was whack-a-mole. Left in place as `recommended: false` so existing installs aren't re-modified unnecessarily, but it's redundant once #61 applies.

name: Enhanced Powergaming Scripts â€” PATCH_TRY wrap around DS CLONE_EFFECT walker
description: Wraps the LPF DELETE_EFFECT + LPF CLONE_EFFECT calls inside `ds_add_detectable_data` (in `enhanced-powergaming-scripts/lib/ds/ds.tph`) with PATCH_TRY / WITH DEFAULT so items with inconsistent ability-header offsets become warnings instead of aborting the entire 'Accelerated Pre-Buffing Speed' component. The underlying bug is WeiDU's CLONE_EFFECT walker crashing with `cannot convert abil_num to an integer` on broken potions â€” Test #38 caught it on POTN18, Test #39 still failed on POTN45 (from ds_simple.2da, a different inline table). Rather than patch each corrupt potion individually, this fix protects the walker call site itself, so ALL corrupted items skip cleanly with a PATCH_PRINT warning. Supersedes patch #60.

ops.find:
COPY_EXISTING "%filespec%" override
              LPF DELETE_EFFECT INT_VAR match_opcode=stat_opcode match_parameter2=stat_param END // clear out any previous version
              LPF CLONE_EFFECT INT_VAR silent=!complain multi_match=1 match_opcode match_parameter2 opcode=stat_opcode parameter1=stat_value parameter2=stat_param special=(opcode=328) STR_VAR match_resource END
        BUT_ONLY

name: Imnesvale â€” replace unknown CLERIC_RESIST_COLD spell with CLERIC_ENDURE_HEAT_COLD
description: All 18 BAF scripts in `imnesvale/scripts/{easy,hard,impossible}/` call `ReallyForceSpell(Myself,CLERIC_RESIST_COLD)` but that symbol doesn't exist in BG2EE's SPELL.IDS â€” the mod was written for pre-EE BG2 where the symbol was defined. WeiDU silently drops each affected line at BCS compile time (observed via `[imnesvale/scripts/easy/duarim.baf] PARSE ERROR at line 16 column 16-58` and 9 similar lines), so creatures never cast cold resistance in combat. Replaces every occurrence with `CLERIC_ENDURE_HEAT_COLD` (spell 1115) â€” a real BG2EE cleric spell that grants both cold AND heat resistance. Semantically closest match; one more side-effect (heat resistance) that makes the creature slightly tougher against fire too, which matches the mod's "hard-encounter" intent. 18 ops, one per BAF, covering all 3 difficulty tiers so the fix works regardless of which component the user selected.

marker._eetmr_marker_note: ducleric.baf has exactly 1 occurrence of CLERIC_RESIST_COLD in every difficulty tier â€” used as the canonical marker. After patch, no file contains CLERIC_RESIST_COLD, so the invert flips to 'already applied'.
